item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02815","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final value 200 after correctly stating the value-increase formula, which yields $600.","case2_error":"Incorrectly converts half a ton to 500 pounds and gives 15 bags, unsupported even by its own formula.","reason":"The first supplies an unsupported number after correct formulas; the second additionally uses an erroneous unit conversion.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02816","case1_error":"Omits the initial 50-yard width, treating the target width as the required increase.","case2_error":"Omits Ariana's half-hour when subtracting completed legs from total time to obtain Sarah's time.","reason":"Both omit an existing component when determining the remaining amount, producing an inflated remainder and downstream result.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02817","case1_error":"Counts five children and five adults instead of three children and two adults in the cost equation.","case2_error":"Represents '$1000 less' with +1000 rather than −1000 in the sale-price equation.","reason":"The first misassigns category counts; the second reverses the direction of a stated monetary adjustment.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02818","case1_error":"Subtracts the six-inch clearance from rim height instead of adding it.","case2_error":"Uses three visits for both Sarah's rooms and five for both Ellie's, misassigning room-specific visit counts.","reason":"The first reverses an offset's direction; the second associates multiplicities with people instead of room types.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02819","case1_error":"Reduces the required rope length by 25% instead of accounting for loss in the purchased rope.","case2_error":"Claims Lyft costs $4 more than Uber, instead of $3 less.","reason":"The first applies a loss factor to the required output; the second changes both the direction and amount of a price comparison.","judgment":"different"}]}
